title: StewardMD Hospital Policy Overlay
description: OPTIONAL, hospital-specific regimen overlay. One file per hospital (kb/policies/<HOSPITAL>.json), keyed internally by disease id. Applied only when the user selects their hospital; it overrides the default ICMR/guideline recommendation for that selection but is never the default. Kept as a SEPARATE, mutable, hospital-owned layer.

hospitalId.description: e.g. GIMSR, AIIMS, APOLLO, ICMR (default overlay), CUSTOM.

diseases.description: Map of Disease.id -> per-hospital policy entry.

hospital.description: Hospital branding + policy metadata (repeated per entry to keep entries self-contained for the UI).

entry.description: The actual regimen overlay for this hospital+disease. null when the hospital declares no specific policy for this disease (hasPolicy:false).

preferred.description: Preferred regimen(s) per the hospital antibiogram/policy.
